tramadol.egypt: Tramadol is not named in Egypt's customs regulations. Decree 430 of 2021, Article 73, only says medicine for personal use is part of a tourist's duty-free luggage at the discretion of the control authority, with no separate rule for narcotics. Because nothing is stated, carry your prescription and ask customs in advance.
tramadol.estonia: Tramadol is not named in Estonia's customs rule. For narcotic or psychotropic medicine the board allows one single retail package of up to 30 units or 25 ml with a prescription copy or doctor's notice, and anything bigger needs State Agency of Medicines authorisation for at most 30 days' treatment.
tramadol.ethiopia: Tramadol is not named in the EFDA's May 2023 guideline, which gives no special rule for narcotic medicines. Personal-use medicine needs no pre-import permit, but the quantity and product information must match your prescription paper. Samples can be taken for testing, and a suspect consignment is quarantined, so bring the original packaging.
tramadol.fiji: Tramadol is not named in Fiji's March 2024 guideline. The traveller rule is the same for every medicine: show an original or certified prescription copy, a prescriber's signed letter with contact details, or a label naming you, the prescriber and the supplier. For a controlled drug the one-month limit in section 11 of the Illicit Drugs Control Act 2004 applies.
tramadol.finland: Tramadol is not named on Finland's travel medicines page. If it is a narcotic in Finland, the supply may not exceed 30 days from a Schengen country or 14 days from a non-Schengen country, and a Schengen certificate is needed inside the Schengen area. Repeat imports must wait until the earlier supply would have run out.
tramadol.georgia: Tramadol is named in Georgia's customs brochure with pregabalin, tianeptine, fentanyl and alprazolam. It may not be imported without relevant medical documentation, and illegal import is a criminal offence under the criminal code. For personal need the limit is a 31-day supply, with an approved English prescription copy and the doctor's certificate.
tramadol.greece: Tramadol is not named in the Schengen decision (Article 75 of the Schengen Convention) that Greece follows. Where a medicine counts as narcotic or psychotropic, a certificate from your national authority is required, valid at most 30 days, with a separate certificate for each drug. The decision does not cover travellers from outside the Schengen area.
tramadol.hungary: Tramadol is not named in Hungary's rule. If it counts as a narcotic drug, only 3 days' treatment is covered by a GP's international certificate; 3 to 90 days needs an official certificate. If it counts as psychotropic, the GP certificate covers up to 30 days. Show the papers at the customs and police check.
tramadol.iceland: Tramadol is not named on the Icelandic Medicines Agency page. If it is a narcotic or psychotropic medicine, the limit is 30 days' supply by defined daily dose, with a physician's certificate, the original prescription or a pharmacy label ready for customs. Posting it to Iceland is not permitted.
tramadol.india: Tramadol is not named in India's customs traveller guide or the CDSCO notice. Narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances are listed as prohibited, and the notice gives no separate rule for them. For other medicines up to 100 average doses of a single drug are allowed. Ask Indian customs whether tramadol is treated as a controlled drug.
tramadol.indonesia: Tramadol is not named in BPOM's leaflet under Regulation 28 of 2023. If it counts as a psychotropic, a doctor's prescription is mandatory and the cap is 60 days of treatment; if a narcotic, it may not be carried at all. Entry is through the Special Access Scheme, with customs deciding to release in full, in part or not.
tramadol.italy: Tramadol is not named in the Italian consulate guidance. If it counts as narcotic or psychotropic, you need an Article 75 certificate valid for 30 days when coming from a Schengen country, issued on prescription. From elsewhere, Italy's Central Narcotics Office has authorised holders of a similar certificate. Customs can confiscate narcotics without authorisation.
tramadol.jamaica: Tramadol is not named on Jamaica's customs or foreign ministry pages. Prescription drugs need a special permit from the Ministry of Health, applied for with a physician's letter, a prescription showing name, strength and quantity for the stay, flight details and your Jamaican address. The pages give no quantity limits, so ask before you fly.
tramadol.jordan: Tramadol is not named in Jordan's traveller regulation, submitted to the INCB in 2025. For narcotic or psychotropic medicines, authorisation must be obtained from the Jordan Food and Drug Administration's control department, and the amount may not exceed six months or the manual's quantity. The filing is a scan, so confirm the details with the authority.
tramadol.latvia: Tramadol is not named in the Latvian rule. If it is a Schedule II or III medicine, a Schengen traveller needs a certificate from the home authority; from elsewhere up to 14 days (Schedule II) or 30 days (Schedule III) is allowed without a permit, showing a prescription or copy. Posting such medicines to Latvia is not allowed.
tramadol.lithuania: Tramadol is named by Lithuanian customs as a narcotic medicine: up to 30 days for travel to a Schengen state and up to 15 days for a non-Schengen state. Carry it only for personal use, in original packaging, in your own name; a Schengen state needs a certificate in the set form, others accept prescription copies.
tramadol.malaysia: Tramadol is not named in Malaysia's Traveller's Guide. If it is controlled under the Dangerous Drugs Act or the psychotropic regulations, bring a valid prescription or doctor's letter with the name, dose and quantity, and declare narcotic-based medicines on arrival. The limit is one month's use, and you can phone +603 7841 3200.
tramadol.maldives: Tramadol is not named by Maldives Customs. It lists narcotics and psychotropic substances as prohibited and requires a valid prescription from a registered medical practitioner to import controlled drugs for personal use. No limits or forms are given on the page, so ask customs.
tramadol.mauritius: Tramadol is not named by the Mauritius Revenue Authority. For controlled medicines you need the Government Pharmacist's approval, a legible prescription, original containers and no more than one month's supply; ordinary prescription medicines may be carried for up to three months with a prescription.
tramadol.mexico: Tramadol is not named by Mexico's ANAM. The page on baggage says personal medicines come in duty-free and that psychotropic substances require the corresponding prescription. Which substances count is not explained on the page, and narcotics are on the separate list of goods you cannot bring in.
tramadol.nepal: We found no official or reliable unofficial source for Nepal on tramadol, so no quantity or permit rule is stated. Tramadol is controlled in many countries. Carry your prescription in the original packaging and confirm the current rule with the Department of Drug Administration (dda.gov.np) before you fly.
tramadol.nigeria: No official traveller rule for tramadol in Nigeria was found, so no limit is stated. Tramadol is controlled in many countries. Carry the prescription in the original packaging and confirm with NAFDAC (nafdac.gov.ng) or a Nigerian embassy before you fly.
tramadol.norway: Tramadol is not named on the NOMA page. If it counts as a narcotic medicine, it must be prescribed to you and documented; a visitor without a Norwegian address can bring up to 30 days' use, declared in the red zone. Longer needs require NOMA permission by post or portal, sent well before arrival.
tramadol.philippines: Tramadol is not named in the Philippine joint circular. Prescription drugs may be brought without FDA clearance if for personal use and the quantity matches the prescription, which shows the physician's licence number. Dangerous drugs and similar substances are left to the Dangerous Drugs Board and PDEA, with no traveller allowance.
tramadol.poland: Tramadol is not named in the Polish text we could confirm. If Poland's list covers it, the Chief Pharmaceutical Inspector (non-EU, non-Schengen travel) or a voivodship inspector (Schengen travel) issues one document per product, within 15 days before you cross, valid for no more than 30 days. Post and courier are not covered.
tramadol.portugal: Tramadol is not named in the Portuguese rule we could confirm. For any substance in tables I-A, II-B, II-C, III or IV, Article 13 of Decree-Law 15/93 allows own use up to 30 days of treatment with a medical document. Carry the document with the medicine.
tramadol.qatar: Tramadol is not named in what we could read of Qatar's controlled-medicine rule. Travellers arriving in or leaving Qatar with controlled medicines need a Ministry of Public Health permit, requested online with a valid prescription. Processing takes three working days after the requirements are complete.
tramadol.romania: Tramadol is not named by Romanian Customs. If your medicine contains a narcotic or psychotropic substance, declare it in writing in every case when entering from a non-EU state. The page gives no quantity limit or document list, and false or missing declarations can be fined or prosecuted.
tramadol.russia: Tramadol is not named by the Federal Customs Service. If a medicine contains narcotic or psychotropic substances, it may be brought in only for medical need, with documents naming the medicine and quantity in Russian or notarised translation, declared in writing. It may not be sent by international post.
tramadol.saudi-arabia: Tramadol is not named in the SFDA notice we could read. For controlled drugs with narcotic or psychotropic substances, travellers need a clearance permit: apply online at cds.sfda.gov.sa with a prescription, a medical report and proof of identity, and watch for the status Submitted, Completed, Rejected or Incomplete.
tramadol.serbia: Tramadol is not named on the Serbian customs page. If it counts as a controlled psychoactive substance, you should get ministry approval for personal import. Otherwise up to 15 days of regular therapy needs no medical opinion. The contact given is the Ministry of Health website, zdravlje.gov.rs.
tramadol.slovakia: Tramadol is not named in Slovakia's 2007 INCB filing. Narcotic drugs are limited to 7 days (Schedule I) or 30 days (Schedule III) of the 1961 Convention, with a valid prescription, and the Schengen agreement applies. The Chief Executive Director of the ministry's Health Care Section is the contact.
tramadol.slovenia: Tramadol is not named on the Slovenian Financial Administration page. If it is treated as an illicit drug used as medication, carry the medical certificate issued or endorsed by the authority of your country of permanent residence. Otherwise, prescription medicine needs proof of the prescription and is limited to three weeks.
tramadol.south-africa: Tramadol is not named in SAHPRA's guideline. For scheduled substances, Regulation 8(1) permits one month's supply for a person entering South Africa with a valid prescription and a prescriber's certificate. SARS lists narcotics and habit-forming drugs as prohibited and allows three months of other personal medicine.
tramadol.south-korea: Tramadol is not named on the MFDS page. Any medicine with a narcotic or psychotropic substance needs a handling approval from the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety for your own treatment, and online applications have been accepted since 27 December 2024. Deadlines and permitted quantities are not stated on the page.
tramadol.spain: Tramadol is not named on the AEMPS page. Narcotic or psychotropic medicines need an AEMPS permit to enter Spain and a certificate to leave. For any other medicine, the quantity must suit the prescribed treatment, not raise suspicion of trafficking, and not exceed three months.
tramadol.cambodia: We found no source for Cambodia on tramadol, so no quantity or permit rule is stated. Tramadol is controlled in many countries. Carry the prescription in the original packaging, bring only a personal supply, and confirm with a Cambodian embassy or customs before you fly.
tramadol.costa-rica: Tramadol is not named in the JVD requirements we could confirm. For medicines under international control, you may carry one month of treatment with ID, prescription and a recent clinical summary in Spanish. Narcotics from Schedule IV of the 1961 Convention and fentanyl ampoules may not be carried.
tramadol.cuba: Tramadol is not named in Cuba's 2022 INCB filing, which lists narcotic and psychotropic substances with maximum amounts for a stay of up to 30 days, for example morphine 3 g and methadone 2 g. If tramadol counts, you need official medical documentation: prescription, endorsed doctor's certificate and Cuban certificate.
tramadol.sri-lanka: Tramadol is not named on the NMRA page. Schedule III medicines are not permitted, so ask the NMRA whether tramadol is listed. Other personal medicine is allowed up to your stay or 90 days, whichever is less, and over 90 days needs NMRA approval in advance.
tramadol.sweden: Tramadol is not named on the Swedish Customs page. If it counts as a narcotic medicine, only personal medical use is allowed, proven by a prescription, label or doctor's certificate, and in some cases a Schengen certificate is needed. The Swedish Medical Products Agency has the full rules.
tramadol.switzerland: Tramadol is not named by Swissmedic, which only says some sleeping aids and strong painkillers count as narcotics. Narcotic medicines may be imported up to 30 days of treatment, with a certificate for each medicine, ideally in hand luggage and original packaging.
tramadol.taiwan: Tramadol is not named on Taiwan's customs page. If it counts as a controlled drug, bring a prescription or supporting document for up to 6 months and a TFDA-certified statement for customs clearance. Anything above the limits needs a TFDA permit and a declaration at the red channel.
tramadol.turkey: Tramadol is not named on Turkey's customs information page, and the page sets no rule for narcotics. Personal-treatment medication is allowed in a reasonable quantity for the length of your stay, carried with you or sent one month before or three months after, with proof of need such as a prescription.
tramadol.new-zealand: Tramadol is not named in the New Zealand rules we read. Medsafe allows three months of a prescription medicine that is not a controlled drug and one month of a controlled one, which must travel with you and be declared on the arrival card. Check tramadol under its ingredient name in the classification database.
tramadol.hong-kong: Tramadol is not named in the Hong Kong Drug Office rules we read. For drugs it lists as dangerous, visitors including those in transit need the Department of Health's written approval first. Ask the Drug Office whether tramadol is listed.
tramadol.australia: Tramadol is not named in the Australian traveller's exemption text we read. Where the exemption applies, up to three months' supply is allowed for you or an immediate family member, with a prescription or doctor's letter naming the medicine and dose, in the original labelled pack, declared to Border Force.
tramadol.canada: Tramadol is not named in the Health Canada travellers' list we read. For substances that are listed, the limit is a 90-day supply based on the usual daily dose, in the container from your health care provider, declared to customs. Ask Health Canada whether tramadol is covered.

vicks-inhaler.united-arab-emirates: A Vicks inhaler is sold for nasal congestion, but the UAE list names levomethamphetamine, its active ingredient, as Psychotropic Schedule II. That is why a common-looking inhaler counts as a controlled medicine there. The allowance is the amount for your stay, up to three months, with a prescription or an attested medical report.
vicks-inhaler.singapore: Levomethamphetamine, the active ingredient of the Vicks inhaler, is named on Appendix A of Singapore’s HSA document guide, so a small nasal inhaler needs approval before you travel. Apply at least two weeks ahead, in English. The HSA says each product should stay in its original container with the pharmacy label.
vicks-inhaler.netherlands: The Dutch government gives no special rule for a Vicks inhaler. Its general advice is that you may bring most medicines to the Netherlands if you can show they are for your own use, in their original packaging so officials recognise them. Medicines under the Opium Act are the exception and need an official certificate. The page sets no quantity figure.
vicks-inhaler.united-states: For a visitor to the United States, the FDA allows a 90-day supply of drug products, and that is the rule behind the card for the Vicks inhaler. US citizens fall under a stricter FDA rule.
vicks-inhaler.ireland: A visitor from outside the Schengen area may bring up to three months’ supply of prescription medicines to Ireland, in packaging that carries their name, and that is the rule the card for the Vicks inhaler follows. Carry the prescription or a letter from your doctor or pharmacist so customs can see the amount fits personal use.
vicks-inhaler.israel: The general rule for medicines entering Israel is a maximum 90-day quantity for your own needs, based on the recommended dosage, and this is the rule behind the Vicks inhaler card. Keep it in its original packaging. The Ministry of Health adds that supplements or vitamins sold over the counter elsewhere may count as medicines needing authorization.
vicks-inhaler.austria: A Vicks inhaler is a small over-the-counter item, and Austria's health ministry allows your usual personal needs, up to three retail packs of the smallest size, with no permit. If it contains a prescription ingredient in your case, bring a doctor's confirmation with the generic name and dose. Keep it in the original packaging so it is clearly labelled.
vicks-inhaler.brazil: A Vicks inhaler counts as personal medicine under Anvisa's baggage rule if the quantity suits your stay and the trip and does not suggest commercial use. A prescription signed by a competent professional may be asked for only when the amount does not fit. Keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.chile: For a Vicks inhaler Chile's customs and ISP rule is that medicines for you or direct family are baggage in the prescribed quantities, and over-the-counter products should cover only your stay. Up to six months of treatment from the prescription is treated as rational use. Unlabelled raw materials are banned; keep the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.croatia: A Vicks inhaler is an ordinary medicine under the rule on Croatia's customs page: only the quantity needed for treatment, up to one month, approved in the manufacturer's country, with medical documentation such as an illness history or physician's certificate. Keep it in the original packaging so customs can see what it is.
vicks-inhaler.czechia: A Vicks inhaler bought outside the European Community may enter the Czech Republic only in the amount matching your normal personal need for the length of your stay, according to the Czech Customs Administration. No pack number is given. Keep it in the original packaging so it is clear what it is.
vicks-inhaler.egypt: A Vicks inhaler counts as medicine for personal use under Egypt's Article 73 of Decree 430 of 2021, which makes it part of a tourist's duty-free luggage when the competent control authority agrees. No number of items is stated. Keep it in the original packaging so the officer can see what it is.
vicks-inhaler.estonia: A Vicks inhaler comes under Estonia's general limit: up to 10 different medicines for personal use and up to 5 retail packages of each without authorisation. The agency's page gives 200 doses as the largest inhalation package. The limits do not apply when arriving from the countries listed, such as Iceland or Switzerland.
vicks-inhaler.ethiopia: For a Vicks inhaler the EFDA's guideline says no pre-import permit is needed for personal-use medicine, but you clear it at the port by showing a prescription from an authorised health professional stating type, description and quantity. Officers check the product and quantity against that prescription.
vicks-inhaler.fiji: A Vicks inhaler carried by a traveller in Fiji needs the same proof as any medicine: an original or certified prescription copy, a signed letter from the prescriber with contact details, or a label identifying you, the prescriber and the supplier. The guideline says to produce it at the border when entering, leaving or transiting. Keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.finland: A Vicks inhaler is a self-administered medicine under Finland's rule: up to a year's supply from the EEA or three months' from outside it, if licensed for sale where you bought it from a licensed seller. If asked, show a prescription or doctor's certificate. Keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.georgia: A Vicks inhaler is not named in Georgia's brochure on controlled medicines. As an ordinary medicine for personal need, up to ten standard packs may be imported without medical documents. More than ten needs medical documents and a daily-dose calculation for the days of the visit. Keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.hungary: A Vicks inhaler is not a controlled substance in the Hungarian rule we could confirm, and medicines that are not controlled need no permit or certificate to enter Hungary. Keep it in the original packaging so customs can see what it is. The certificates and 90-day limits apply only to controlled substances.
vicks-inhaler.iceland: A Vicks inhaler counts as a general medicine for the Icelandic Medicines Agency: up to 100 days' supply from outside the EEA, or a year's from within it. If customs asks, present a physician's certificate, the original prescription or the pharmacy label. Posting it from outside the EEA is not permitted.
vicks-inhaler.india: A Vicks inhaler can be part of your bona fide baggage in India as a small personal-use quantity, up to 100 average doses of any single drug, declared to customs if asked, according to the CDSCO notice under Rule 36. For more you need a Form 12-B permit, applied for in Form 12-A with a prescription from a registered practitioner.
vicks-inhaler.indonesia: BPOM's leaflet counts inhalers among the semi-solid, liquid and aerosol forms: without a prescription, up to 3 pieces per product per person. With a doctor's prescription, up to a maximum of 90 days of treatment. Personal medicines go through BPOM's Special Access Scheme, and customs decides whether to release them.
vicks-inhaler.italy: A Vicks inhaler comes under Italy's general rule that carried medicines have no specific requirements, as long as it contains no narcotic or psychotropic substance. Only those need the Article 75 certificate valid for 30 days. Keep it in the original packaging so it is clear what it is.
vicks-inhaler.latvia: A Vicks inhaler must be in its original packaging with the manufacturer identifiable and come with a purchase receipt or equivalent document, says Latvia's State Agency of Medicines. Up to 12 months of use from an EEA country or 6 months from a third country; over three packaging units needs a written statement of personal use.
vicks-inhaler.lithuania: A Vicks inhaler counts among the medicines Lithuania lets you bring or receive by post up to 10 packs at a time, once a calendar month, with no doctor's certificate. The limits do not apply to narcotic or psychotropic medicines. Customs may ask for a certificate naming the patient, medicine, strength and duration.
vicks-inhaler.malaysia: A Vicks inhaler can be carried into Malaysia for your own use or an immediate family member travelling with you, in the amount reasonably needed for one month, determined by the dosage label. Keep the original packaging. Only products registered with the Drug Control Authority may be imported.
vicks-inhaler.mauritius: If a Vicks inhaler is carried as a prescription medicine, Mauritius Customs asks for a legible prescription saying it is used under a doctor's direction, original containers and no more than a three-month supply. Controlled medicines need the Government Pharmacist's approval and are limited to one month.
vicks-inhaler.mexico: A Vicks inhaler for your own use counts as a personal medicine under Mexico's ANAM baggage page, which lets travellers bring medicines for personal use duty-free. No quantity limit is given, and the prescription rule on that page applies only to psychotropic substances. Keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.norway: A Vicks inhaler counts as an ordinary medicine for NOMA: up to 3 months' use from outside the EEA or up to a year's from within it, with proof it is for your own use. Keep it in the original packaging. Narcotic medicines have separate, shorter 30-day limits and use the red zone.
vicks-inhaler.philippines: A Vicks inhaler can come into the Philippines without FDA clearance if it is for personal use in passenger baggage, a balikbayan box or mail, under the 2015 joint circular. The quantity should match the prescription showing the doctor's PRC licence number or foreign equivalent. Above the limits it can be seized and forfeited, and duties may apply.
vicks-inhaler.russia: A Vicks inhaler is allowed without permit documents in Russia if it contains no narcotic or psychotropic substances, under Eurasian Economic Union law as described by the Federal Customs Service. To confirm, check the composition and the Ministry of Health's state register (GRLS). Keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.serbia: A Vicks inhaler for regular therapy up to 15 days can be carried into Serbia without a medical opinion, says the Customs Administration. A larger quantity for a stay of more than 15 days and up to six months, or more than one package of up to 30 dosage units, needs approval from the competent ministry.
vicks-inhaler.slovenia: A Vicks inhaler is a medicine for personal use under Slovenia's rule: up to three weeks for acute conditions when arriving from outside the EU, or up to 12 months exceptionally for chronic conditions with proof of permitted residence. Proof of prescription is needed only if the medicine requires one.
vicks-inhaler.south-africa: For a Vicks inhaler, SARS allows personal medicines of up to three months' use with a prescription or doctor's letter, but SAHPRA's regulation limits scheduled substances to one month with a prescription and a prescriber's certificate. Keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.south-korea: A Vicks inhaler falls within the general limit for other medicines in South Korea: up to 6 bottles or a 3-month supply, with proof of personal use such as a prescription, medical certificate or pharmacy label, in the original packaging. The MFDS permit is only for narcotic or psychotropic medicines.
vicks-inhaler.spain: A Vicks inhaler counts among the general medicines AEMPS covers: the quantity must suit your treatment, must not look like trafficking and must not exceed three months. You may be asked for a prescription or medical report when entering or leaving Spain. Keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.sri-lanka: A Vicks inhaler can be carried in Sri Lanka without NMRA approval for the length of your stay or up to 90 days, whichever is less. Keep it in its original container, or label it with name, strength and instructions, and carry a prescription or medical records. Intramuscular and intravenous medicines are not permitted.
vicks-inhaler.sweden: A Vicks inhaler for personal use is limited by Swedish Customs to three months' consumption from outside the EEA, or one year's from another EEA country. Proof can be a prescription, pharmacy label or doctor's certificate. Keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.switzerland: A Vicks inhaler is a non-narcotic medicine under Swissmedic's rule: up to one month's supply for your own use, with no certificate or documents needed, based on the leaflet dose. You may not bring medicines for someone else. Keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.taiwan: A Vicks inhaler counts as a non-prescription medicine in Taiwan's customs rule: up to 12 bottles or packages per type and 36 in total, for personal use only. Above those amounts you need a TFDA permit for clearance and must use the red channel. Keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.turkey: A Vicks inhaler is a personal-treatment medication under Turkey's Annex-9 rule: a reasonable quantity for your stay, with a medical report or doctor's prescription to show at customs. It may travel with you or be sent one month before or three months after your arrival. Keep the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.argentina: The Argentine page on Resolution 66/2000 does not mention levomethamphetamine, the ingredient our list gives for a Vicks inhaler. Its prescription rule is for narcotic or psychotropic medicines and gives no amount limit. If you are unsure whether an inhaler counts, ask ANMAT before you travel and keep it in its original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.bahrain: Bahrain's 7-day rule applies to narcotic and psychotropic medicines and needs a Bahraini health-authority certificate. Levomethamphetamine, the ingredient in a Vicks inhaler, is not named in the filing, so we cannot say whether it counts. Ask Bahrain's health regulator before you fly, and carry the inhaler in its original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.belgium: A Vicks inhaler is not among the examples Belgium's agency gives of controlled medicines, so the Schengen declaration and 3-month limit it describes are not stated to apply. Whether levomethamphetamine is on the Belgian list is not confirmed here. Ask a pharmacist or the agency, FAMHP, before you travel.
vicks-inhaler.bulgaria: The Bulgarian customs FAQ rule on narcotic substances, limited to 30 days' worth with a prescribing-country document, does not name levomethamphetamine. Whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask the Customs Agency if you are unsure, and keep the inhaler in its original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.cambodia: We found no source for Cambodia on a Vicks inhaler, so no limit or permit rule is stated. Because we cannot confirm how Cambodia treats levomethamphetamine, ask a Cambodian embassy or health authority first, and keep the inhaler in its original packaging with a doctor's letter if you have one.
vicks-inhaler.colombia: Article 59 of Colombia's resolution allows a standard 30-day treatment of listed narcotics and psychotropics with a copy of the prescription. Levomethamphetamine is not named in it, so we cannot confirm whether a Vicks inhaler is covered. Ask a Colombian pharmacist before you fly.
vicks-inhaler.costa-rica: The Costa Rican one-month rule with documents translated into Spanish applies to substances under international control. Levomethamphetamine is not named in the text we could confirm, so whether a Vicks inhaler is covered is not stated. Ask the Drug Surveillance Board if unsure.
vicks-inhaler.cuba: Cuba's Resolution 104/2022 lists named narcotics and psychotropics with maximum amounts and prohibits cannabis, coca, cocaine and heroin. Levomethamphetamine is not named in the text we could read, so a Vicks inhaler is not stated to be affected. The filing is a scan, so confirm with the Cuban health ministry.
vicks-inhaler.cyprus: Cyprus requires a permit from the Inspection Department for small quantities of internationally controlled medicines. Levomethamphetamine is not named in what we could read, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask the Pharmaceutical Services, and keep it in its original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.denmark: Denmark's Medicines Agency limits euphoriant medicines to a 30-day supply from lists B to E, with a prescription or Schengen certificate if asked. Levomethamphetamine is not named on the page. Look it up in the Executive Order on Euphoriant Substances or write to dkma@dkma.dk.
vicks-inhaler.dominican-republic: The Dominican customs manual allows medicines for personal use and asks for a prescription for controlled or psychotropic substances. Levomethamphetamine is not named, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask the Dirección General de Aduanas at INFO@ADUANAS.GOB.DO.
vicks-inhaler.france: The ANSM page asks for the original prescription and does not name levomethamphetamine. A Vicks inhaler is therefore not stated to be restricted in France, but we cannot confirm it. Ask a French pharmacist, and keep the inhaler in its original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.germany: Germany's BfArM page covers narcotic medicines with the Article 75 certificate. Levomethamphetamine is not named in it, so we cannot say if a Vicks inhaler counts. Ask your doctor or a German pharmacist, and keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.greece: Greece relies on a Schengen decision about narcotic and psychotropic medicines that names no drugs. Whether levomethamphetamine in a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask the Ministry of Health's Narcotic Drugs Division, Greece's central authority, and keep the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.jamaica: Jamaica's rule needs a special permit for prescription drugs, applied for with a physician's letter and prescription copy. Levomethamphetamine is not named, so whether a Vicks inhaler is a prescription item there is not stated. Ask Jamaica Customs at public.relations@jca.gov.jm.
vicks-inhaler.japan: Japan prohibits amphetamine for individual travellers even with a foreign prescription. Whether levomethamphetamine in a Vicks inhaler is treated the same way is not stated in the text we read, and the similar name makes it worth checking. Ask Japan's health ministry before you fly.
vicks-inhaler.jordan: Jordan's INCB filing requires authorisation from the Jordan Food and Drug Administration for narcotics and psychotropics, six months at most. Levomethamphetamine is not named, and the filing is a scan we could not read. Ask the authority whether a Vicks inhaler is covered.
vicks-inhaler.kenya: Kenya's 30-day rule applies to narcotic and psychotropic substances, with the original prescription shown at Customs. Levomethamphetamine is not named, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask the Pharmacy and Poisons Board, and keep the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.kuwait: Kuwait's filing bans narcotics and limits psychotropics to schedules 2, 3 and 4, naming no drugs. Whether levomethamphetamine in a Vicks inhaler counts is therefore not stated. Ask the Kuwaiti health authorities before you travel and keep the inhaler in its original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.lebanon: Lebanon's filing sets 7 days for narcotics and 30 days for psychotropics and needs Ministry of Public Health approval. Levomethamphetamine is not named, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask the ministry, and keep it in the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.luxembourg: Luxembourg's filing gives no day or quantity limit and names no drugs, so levomethamphetamine in a Vicks inhaler is not mentioned. The documents it asks for apply to controlled medicines. Ask a Luxembourg pharmacist if you are unsure.
vicks-inhaler.maldives: Maldives Customs says controlled drugs for personal use need a prescription and lists narcotics as prohibited goods, without naming levomethamphetamine. Whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask customs before you travel.
vicks-inhaler.malta: Malta's filing names no drugs and no limits, so levomethamphetamine in a Vicks inhaler is not mentioned. The only requirement is a valid prescription for controlled medicines. Ask the Superintendent of Public Health at St Luke's Hospital if unsure.
vicks-inhaler.morocco: Morocco's filing asks for extra paper for controlled medicines, including an authorisation for a medicine not sold there. Levomethamphetamine is not named, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask Moroccan health authorities before you fly.
vicks-inhaler.nepal: No source we could verify covers a Vicks inhaler in Nepal. We cannot confirm how Nepal treats levomethamphetamine, so ask the Department of Drug Administration (dda.gov.np) or a Nepali embassy, and carry the inhaler in its original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.nigeria: We found no official source for Nigeria on a Vicks inhaler. We cannot confirm how Nigeria treats levomethamphetamine, so ask NAFDAC (nafdac.gov.ng) or customs (customs.gov.ng) and keep the inhaler in its original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.oman: Oman's filing covers narcotics and psychotropics with a 30-day limit and a recent medical report. Levomethamphetamine is not named, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask Oman's health authorities, and keep the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.panama: Panama's 90-day rule applies to narcotics and psychotropics with a prescription and endorsed certificate. Levomethamphetamine is not named, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask Panamanian health authorities before travelling.
vicks-inhaler.peru: Peru's filing sets 5 days for narcotics and the prescribed amount for psychotropics, with some listed substances treated differently. Levomethamphetamine is not named in the part we read, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask Peruvian authorities.
vicks-inhaler.poland: Poland's inspectorate document, one per product, covers medicines on the narcotic and psychotropic list. Levomethamphetamine is not named in what we could confirm, so whether a Vicks inhaler is covered is not stated. Ask the Chief Pharmaceutical Inspectorate.
vicks-inhaler.portugal: Article 13 of Portugal's Decree-Law 15/93 covers tables I-A, II-B, II-C, III and IV, 30 days, with a medical document. Levomethamphetamine is not named in what we confirmed, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask Infarmed.
vicks-inhaler.qatar: Qatar requires a Ministry of Public Health permit for controlled medicines with a valid prescription. Levomethamphetamine is not named in what we could read, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask the ministry, and apply early if needed.
vicks-inhaler.romania: Romanian Customs requires a written declaration for medicines with narcotic or psychotropic substances, with fines for wrong declarations. Levomethamphetamine is not named, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask customs if you are unsure.
vicks-inhaler.saudi-arabia: The SFDA permit applies to controlled drugs with narcotic or psychotropic substances, applied for at cds.sfda.gov.sa. Levomethamphetamine is not named in the notice, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask the SFDA before you fly.
vicks-inhaler.seychelles: Seychelles' filing sets 30 days for narcotics and 90 for psychotropics and needs certificates. Levomethamphetamine is not named in the part we read, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask Seychelles health authorities.
vicks-inhaler.slovakia: Slovakia's filing from 2007 covers narcotics and psychotropics by schedule and does not name levomethamphetamine, so a Vicks inhaler is not stated to be covered. The ministry's Department of Pharmacy is the contact for details.
vicks-inhaler.thailand: Thailand's FDA rule sorts controlled medicines by schedule and sets 30-day and 90-day tiers. Levomethamphetamine is not named in the part we read, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask the Thai FDA.
vicks-inhaler.ukraine: Ukraine's filing sets small amounts for narcotics and psychotropics and names no drugs, so levomethamphetamine in a Vicks inhaler is not mentioned. Whether it counts is not stated; ask Ukrainian health authorities and carry the prescription if you have one.
vicks-inhaler.vietnam: Vietnam's 2019 customs page sets 7 and 10-day limits for narcotic and psychotropic or precursor drugs. Levomethamphetamine is not named, so whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated. Ask Vietnamese customs, and carry the prescription if you have one.
vicks-inhaler.new-zealand: A Vicks inhaler's levomethamphetamine is not named in the New Zealand rules we read. Medsafe asks you to look the ingredient up in its classification database. If it is a prescription medicine that is not controlled, up to three months in the original container is allowed; controlled drugs are limited to one month and must be declared.
vicks-inhaler.hong-kong: Levomethamphetamine, in a Vicks inhaler, is not named in the Hong Kong rules we read, which cover dangerous drugs listed in the First Schedule of Cap. 134. Whether it is listed is not stated. Ask the Drug Office before you travel, and keep the inhaler in its original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.china: Levomethamphetamine is not named in the parts of China's 2025 catalogue we read. Shanghai Customs's rule is to declare controlled medicines and carry papers, with customs deciding on personal use and reasonable quantity. Whether a Vicks inhaler counts is not stated; ask Chinese customs and keep the original packaging.
vicks-inhaler.australia: A Vicks inhaler's levomethamphetamine is not named in the Australian traveller's exemption we read. The general limit is up to three months' supply, for you or an immediate family member on the trip, with the original label. Ask the Office of Drug Control if you are unsure whether it counts.
vicks-inhaler.canada: Levomethamphetamine is not named in Health Canada's traveller rules we read, so a Vicks inhaler is not stated to be controlled there. Pseudoephedrine, a Class A precursor, has its own 3 g limit, which is different. Keep the inhaler in the original packaging and ask Health Canada if you are unsure.
vicks-inhaler.united-kingdom: Levomethamphetamine is not named in the UK Home Office guidance we read, so a Vicks inhaler is not stated to need a licence. The three-month rule applies to Schedule 2 to 4 drugs prescribed to you abroad. Keep the inhaler in the original packaging and ask a UK pharmacist.

cbd-oil.thailand: Thailand’s FDA travel page does not mention cannabidiol, so it gives no answer for CBD oil on its own. The card above applies the general rule only if the product counts as a controlled medicine. In that case a permit is needed for narcotics or for psychotropic supplies of 31 to 90 days, applied for online 15 days ahead. Confirm with the FDA before you pack it.
cbd-oil.panama: CBD oil is not mentioned in Panama’s January 2025 filing to the UN narcotics board. cbd-oil.bahrain: CBD oil does not appear in Bahrain’s February 2024 filing to the UN narcotics board. Ask the National Health Regulatory Authority (cunp@nhra.bh) whether CBD counts before you pack it.
cbd-oil.singapore: Singapore’s HSA document guide names cannabidiol among its examples of prohibited substances, next to cannabis extracts and THC. Unlike controlled medicines, these cannot be approved: the HSA says personal imports are not permitted under any circumstances. CBD oil therefore stays at home, whatever the prescription says.
cbd-oil.united-kingdom: The UK Home Office distinguishes pure CBD from consumer CBD products. cbd-oil.japan: Japan Customs says that importing cannabis or cannabis products is forbidden, even for medical use.
